description: Track all pipeline run metadata in ClickHouse
steps: Write ClickHouse DDL for pipeline_runs (MergeTree, ORDER BY (stage, started_at))
Schema: run_id, stage (bronze/silver/gold), started_at, ended_at, status (success/failed/running), input_snapshot_id, output_snapshot_id, rows_written, bytes_written, error
Create src/prediction_data/gold/ops_metadata.py with PipelineRunTracker class
Instrument Gold process-trades, compute-marks, compute-wallet-metrics to emit pipeline_runs records
Write helper: start_run() returns run context, end_run() writes completion record

description: Track partition-level metadata for all Gold datasets
steps: Write ClickHouse DDL for dataset_partitions (ReplacingMergeTree(written_at), ORDER BY (dataset, partition_day_utc))
Schema: dataset, partition_day_utc, row_count, max_event_ts, written_at, run_id
Emit partition records after each Gold write (S3 or CH)
Support querying: 'what partitions exist for market_mark_daily?' and 'what was the last partition written?'

description: Freshness tracking with SLA monitoring and alerting states
steps: Write ClickHouse DDL for dataset_freshness (ReplacingMergeTree(last_success_at), ORDER BY dataset)
Schema: dataset, last_success_at, expected_lag_seconds, actual_lag_seconds, state (fresh/stale/broken), last_run_id
Define default SLAs: market_mark_daily=300s, wallet_pnl_daily=600s, wallet_mtm_daily=900s, wallet_position_snapshot_daily=900s
Create freshness checker: compare last_success_at to current time and SLA thresholds
Compute alerting state: fresh (within SLA), stale (> SLA and <= 2x SLA), broken (> 2x SLA or last run failed)
Add CLI command: `prediction-data gold freshness` to display current freshness status of all datasets
Write ClickHouse DDL for data_quality_metrics (MergeTree, ORDER BY (dataset, partition, run_id))
Schema: dataset, partition, check_name, status (pass/fail/warn), observed_value, expected, run_id
Add quality checks to Gold processing: non-null keys, reasonable price ranges, PnL sanity
Emit quality records after each processing run
Write unit tests for freshness state computation logic
Write integration test: run a Gold processing job → verify pipeline_runs, dataset_partitions, and freshness records exist in CH
Verify freshness CLI output matches expected format
